run_f_gold: run f_gold to count Fibonacci numbers within a given low and high range
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets to verify correct Fibonacci range counting
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use logarithmic time instead of linear iteration over Fibonacci numbers
review_f_gold: review f_gold for edge cases where low exceeds high or range contains no Fibonacci numbers
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which iterates Fibonacci sequence and counts values falling within a specified range
